description: ACES calibration samples: periodic primitive unit cells, t/a [0.08, 0.12, 0.16], Re [1.0, 3.0, 10.0], Air at 320 K, 96 voxels per cell.
hypothesis: Pressure drop and H1 heat transfer of TPMS cores differ from the straight-duct baselines by a factor that is constant enough over this range to calibrate the fast tier.
expected: dpdx and H1 h per case (rows carry boundary uniform_heat_flux); fitted with `aces calibrate`, which takes the boundary from the rows.
rd_activity: ACES fast-tier calibration of TPMS heat-exchanger cores
